_comment: Hooks for every agent, from one place. script: a file in core/hooks/ (.py runs with Python 3, .sh with bash); command: a command line. event: the Claude Code event name. matcher: per-agent tool-name regex for PreToolUse; an agent without one does not get the hook. blocks: the hook may block (exit 2); other hooks never block. SessionStart hooks print context for the new session. Cursor imports the Claude Code hooks from ~/.claude/settings.json.
